review_texts: I love this app. It's new to me but my favorite features are the ability to change font so I can read it even if I forget my reading glasses and how it tracks my progress. I am still trying to figure out how to add my favourite verses so a little"how to use guide" would be helpful in that subject alone, the rest of the app. is very easy to use.

Since I first found this app. I noticed that it's user friendly and features for highlighting for verse's. It keeps track of Your bible reading progress as well. Plus there's other nice features. I honestly think I've had this app. For seven years and I still use it daily.
